obs.note: x_norm = (x - offset) / scale; features as lunarsim/atc/learned.py

act.note: the robot bids bid - urgency_usd_per_h * output (score = -bid / urgency_usd_per_h + output)

training.algo: imitation of O_ORACLE (DAgger), then the cross-entropy method on mean urgent wait

imitation.teacher: O_ORACLE: the full-information pooled marketplace on the same auction state
imitation.finding: imitation reproduces the hand-built bids: their top item is the oracle's item for the robot in 92.9 % of held-out rounds, and every disagreement is an item the oracle gives another robot in the same round (318 of 318 at 30 % load, 404 of 404 at 60 %, seeds 2000/2001); both the MLP and the linear model reach their best held-out agreement with no correction (g = 0), so DAgger iterations 1-4 were not run

cem.fitness: mean urgent wait (censored, h), C_LEARNED, loss 0.10, 30 % load, common random numbers: seeds [1000, 1002, 1004, 1006] for every candidate
cem.selection: mean of each generation on tuning seeds [2000, 2002, 2004]; the best one is exported

card.what: learned correction to the on-Moon auction's hand-built bids (B-74)
card.honest_size: a small MLP (12-32-32-1) or a linear model; the papers call it a learned bidding policy
card.teacher: O_ORACLE (the full-information pooled marketplace) on the same auction state
